# Short-Answer Exams

* All exams are take-home, open-note, open-book. This means that you may use any materials provided by the instructor for class as you complete the exam. 

* There is no time limit on the exam. You are free to ask Angie questions as you complete the exam. You can email or speak with me in person.

* You are NOT allowed to discuss the exam with anyone except Angie Roles, even after you have submitted it. 

* You are not allowed to use internet resources that were not provided by the instructor.

* Violation of any of the above will be reported as an Honor Code violation.

## Exam 1 - due Oct 2

Exam 1 covers course material through the end of Week 5 (Sep 25). 

You can access [Exam 1 here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tlh6gOynHN3jsrQlDlBSNCSHC-iDrr0kIgYzAowZL8Y/edit?usp=sharing). Make a copy for yourself and then type into the doc. Or you can create a separate doc for your responses. Use the link at the top of the website to submit the completed exam.
